parameters.query:
select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where status='sucesso') as sucesso, count(*) filter (where status='erro') as erros,
 coalesce(round(avg(tempo_ms)),0) as tempo_medio_ms, coalesce(sum(custo_estimado),0) as custo,
 count(*) filter (where nota_usuario='nao_util') as nao_util,
 (select coalesce(json_agg(e),'[]'::json) from (select left(erro_mensagem,120) as erro, count(*) as n from public.gideon_execucoes where data_hora > now()-interval '7 days' and status='erro' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 3) e) as top_erros,
 (select count(*) from public.gideon_memoria where criado_em > now()-interval '7 days') as memorias_novas,
 (select count(*) from public.gideon_tarefas where status='aberta') as tarefas_abertas,
 (select count(*) from public.gideon_lembretes where enviado_em > now()-interval '7 days') as lembretes_enviados
from public.gideon_execucoes where data_hora > now() - interval '7 days'
